name: Onii-chan Daisuki!
source:
Osamu is the protagonist of the story, and he always has a sister complex. He has taken care of his little sister, Rio, from the moment she was born, as well as his other sister, Mio, since she joined his family from his father’s remarriage. Every day he was on cloud nine being together with his two younger sisters.

Finally came the day when they started attending the nearby school that he also went to. When he saw them in their school uniforms for the first time, his heart started beating faster as he gazed upon their slightly matured figures. Could it be love? Yes, he had begun to have a (sexual) affection for them.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2017/07/19/july-2017-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
故事的主角绵谷理一直是个妹控。亲妹妹里樱从出生起就是他照顾的，父亲再婚后加入这个家的另一个妹妹美樱，他也从那时起一直照料。每天都能和两个妹妹待在一起，对他来说简直幸福极了。

终于，她们也进了他就读的那所学校。第一次看见她们穿上制服，他望着妹妹们稍显成熟的身形，不由得心跳加快。这是爱吗？是的，他开始对她们产生了好感（性方面的）。

[摘自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2017/07/19/july-2017-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
